phase1_leaf_result.part122_scope: One bounded 24-cell least-privilege authority-separation model across three authority classes and eight force-push/policy/repository/credential/retry/interruption events.
phase1_leaf_result.new_narrowing: Least-privilege workers with no Administration/ruleset/repository-lifecycle authority remove the two structural meta-authority failures seen in Part121. Generic Contents(write) still includes raw Git-ref update/delete, so a current no-bypass ref fence or a Chat execution surface that omits raw-ref mutation is required. CAS plus identity/policy revalidation and exact readback handles stale claims, response loss, revocation, and rate limits only while those preconditions hold.
phase1_leaf_result.minimal_unresolved_child: Can a Chat-native repository transport expose an already-enforced least-privilege worker capability boundary and stable repository incarnation binding as observable invariants, with no manual/admin provisioning step and no external monotonic witness?

phase1_acceptance.scope_guard: Worker-originated concurrency/idempotency only; not owner/admin compromise or repository-lifecycle safety. Inputs were current own multi_agent state and current official public GitHub documentation only.

zero_dependency_zero_quota_assessment.richer_mode_protected_manual_execution_d: unresolved_for_acceptance: least-privilege/protection preconditions are not yet Chat-natively proven without admin/manual provisioning

continuation: Part123: execute one bounded capability-surface invariant model. Compare (a) connected Chat repository tool surface that exposes only content-file CAS writes, (b) generic Contents(write) token with raw-ref endpoints, and (c) selected-repository GitHub App installation binding. Test whether capability introspection plus repository-id/install binding can prove, without admin/manual setup, that a worker cannot force-rewind, edit policy, or bind to a delete/recreated repository. Include token rotation/revocation and rate-limit fail-closed controls. If the installed capability boundary cannot be proven from Chat-native observable state, preserve it as the minimal unresolved child; persist one checkpoint and no second leaf.
